# SKI Construction
> Build With Quality

SKI Construction is a premier construction and engineering company located in Kinathukadavu, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. Led by Er. D. Satheeshkumar (DCE., BE., Registered LBS Engineer), the firm provides end-to-end residential and commercial building construction, architectural 3D elevation design, structural planning, and statutory government approval services.

## Core Services
1. Building Construction (/services/building-construction)
   Complete turnkey residential and commercial building construction with supervised engineering, quality materials, and transparent stage-wise delivery.

2. 3D Elevation Design (/services/3d-elevation-design)
   Photorealistic exterior 3D elevations, architectural facades, material selections, and daylight simulations before on-site execution.

3. Construction Consulting (/services/construction-consulting)
   Independent structural guidance, plan assessments, material quality vetting, and contractor workflow scheduling.

4. Bank Loan Estimate (/services/bank-loan-estimate)
   Bank-format construction estimates, stage valuation documentation, and civil engineering verification for smooth loan sanctions.

5. LBS Plan Approval (/services/lbs-plan-approval)
   Coimbatore Corporation registered Licensed Building Surveyor (LBS) building plan drafting, submission, and statutory approvals.

6. DTCP / LPA Approval (/services/dtcp-lpa-approval)
   Directorate of Town and Country Planning (DTCP) and Local Planning Authority (LPA) layout sanction drawings and documentation.

7. Vastu Plan (/services/vastu-plan)
   Traditional Vastu Shastra principles integrated with modern architectural floor plans for optimal natural lighting, airflow, and spatial harmony.

8. Real Estate (/services/real-estate)
   Clear-title residential plots, agricultural lands, and development properties evaluated with legal and developmental scrutiny across Coimbatore.

9. Property Buying & Selling (/services/property-buying-selling)
   Transparent real estate brokering and property transaction services connecting verified buyers and property owners in the Kinathukadavu and Coimbatore regions.
